newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MIM says Alumbrera costs have risen.
newsitem.headline: MIM says Alumbrera costs have risen.

text.p: Mining house MIM Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that the capital costs of the Bajo de la Alumbrera copper and gold mining project in Argentina would increase to between US$1.05 billion and US$1.1 billion from the US$903 million estimate of July last year.
The company, which has a 50 percent stake in the project, said the cost increase was due to the effects of particularly heavy summer rains and other possible cost revisions.
MIM's partners are North Ltd and Rio Algom Ltd, each with 25 percent.
